notes: An alpha-masked region crop of the fixture master, frame-aligned to it (it reuses the master's control points, so it warps onto the same canvas place). It carries a binary alpha mask (make_source.build_crop: opaque only right of CROP_SPLIT_X, with a transparent hole punched inside) and an extra interior line the master lacks, at boundary precedence 50 — above the master (40) and the alias sibling (20). It exists to pin the src_valid / alpha-footprint path: the fixture asserts the crop contributes cells ONLY where alpha>0, and that the master's cell survives showing through the crop's transparent hole rather than being blanked and Voronoi-refilled — the exact failure a `.convert("RGB")` that dropped the alpha would produce.

control_points.note: centre, pulled off the affine (matches master)
